# Finding Peace in the Storm

## Scripture

"Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid." - John 14:27

## Reflection

When life gets turbulent, it's easy to feel overwhelmed by the storm raging around us. But Jesus reminds us that He is the source of true peace. This peace is not like the world's fleeting comfort, but a deep, abiding sense of calm that comes from knowing and trusting in Him. We don't have to be controlled by our emotions or circumstances. We can choose to rest in the peace that Jesus offers.

As we navigate life's challenges, let's remember that Jesus is with us, guiding and directing us. He is our rock, our shelter, and our peace. We can trust Him to work everything out for our good, even when we can't see the way ahead. Let's learn to be still, to quiet our minds and hearts, and to listen for His gentle whisper.

## Prayer

We pray for the peace that only You can give, Lord. Help us to trust in Your presence and guidance, even in the midst of chaos. Calm our fears and doubts, and fill us with Your peace.

## One-Line Application

We can find peace in the storm by choosing to trust in Jesus' presence and guidance.
